# CryptoDrop (cryptoairdropai.com)

CryptoDrop tracks and verifies free crypto token airdrops across Ethereum, Solana, Base, Arbitrum, and every major blockchain. 

## Key Resources
- Homepage: https://cryptoairdropai.com
- Latest Airdrops: https://cryptoairdropai.com/latest
- Confirmed Airdrops: https://cryptoairdropai.com/confirmed
- Hot Airdrops: https://cryptoairdropai.com/hot
- Farming Guides: https://cryptoairdropai.com/guides
- FAQ: https://cryptoairdropai.com/faq
- About & Trust: https://cryptoairdropai.com/about

## Core Concept
Crypto airdrops are free distributions of tokens from a blockchain project to wallet addresses that meet specific criteria (like early usage, providing liquidity, or completing on-chain tasks). We verify these opportunities so users don't fall for scams.
